claim: Monitoring Analytics reports that PJM capacity prices rose from $28.92/MW-day to $269.92/MW-day between the 2024/2025 and 2025/2026 auctions, an 833% increase.
comparisonContext: This makes the regional consumer-cost discussion much more concrete than abstract grid-pressure language alone.
scopeNote: Auction-price change in PJM, not a national average consumer bill increase.
sourceTitle: Analysis of the 2025/2026 RPM Base Residual Auction: Part G (Revised)
